(At least three cores on this Nexus) Your "Astral Dragon"/"Superstar" family effects that target the opposing Field are treated as colorless, and the limit of their "BP Destruction effects" increase by +5000.

(Once per turn, send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) Either return a "Wurm" from your Trash to your Hand, or deploy a "Bashin Dan"/"Viole Mai" from your Trash by paying one cost.

(Once per Turn: Same Name) While you control an "Astral Deity"/"Galaxian" family Grandwalker Nexus, including in Soul State, this card can be used from the Trash.

[Flash]
During this turn, every opposing Spirit/Ultimate loses Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue symbols, one of each. Then, return this card to the deckbottom.

BSC50-041.name: We'll Be Fine Now.
BSC50-041.effect:
This card sent to the Trash from the deck by the effect of your "Viole Mai" can be added to the Hand. When you've done so, +1 core to a Grandwalker Nexus you control.

When your Life is reduced by the opponent, if you control any "Viole Mai", you can use this card from the Hand without paying the cost.

[Flash]
During this turn, your Life can't be reduced by the attacks of opposing Spirits/Ultimates with two cores or less on them. Also, if you control any "Viole Mai", during this turn, your Life can't be reduced by the attacks of opposing Brave Spirits/Brave Ultimates.
